title: Artifacts and souls
description:
Mobs drop souls that can later be turned into gold iron and diamond and subsequently awaken them on a special table.
after that, you can use all the souls for a variety of crafts, from an amulet giving strength to a staff of seas shooting compacted water
body:
Mobs drop common _souls_ upon death. These souls can be upgraded on a crafting table into iron, gold, and diamond tiers, and subsequently awakened on a special _upgrader_ table to fill them with elemental powers - Water, Light, Earth, Cosmic, or End.

Tools and Crushers: Heavy tools are added (such as the _Earth Hammer_ and _Cosmic Crusher_) to break blocks in a 3x3 area, as well as universal elemental multitools.

Relics and Flora: The _Dodge Ring_ grants a chance to dodge attacks. You can also craft the _Sword of Light, Staff of Seas_, and _End Amulet_, or collect _Void Berries_ that grant night vision.

Soul Side Effects: Eating mob souls grants their properties, which can cause you to explode (from a creeper soul) or burn in the sun (from a zombie or skeleton soul).

### Boss Summoning (using the BossSummoner item):
**_Soul Skeleton_** — summoned by clicking the item on a built tower made of a diamond block, quartz, and soul sand. It drops its soul to craft the Soul Spear weapon and armor with fire resistance.

**_Upgrader-Spider_** — summoned by clicking the item on an upgrader block. It drops a poisoned soul to craft a poisoned dagger.
